scope: Table 87 /Measure and /PtData on image XObjects, traced through effective EC3 §§12.9–12.10 and the current page-measurement query. This is a focused consumer review, not a complete image or geospatial certification.

locators.locator: Bounds and LPTS mapping to Viewport/image/form XObject
PtData extended data and tuple semantics

effective_rules: Table 87: image /Measure is optional PDF 2.0 and specifies scale and units that shall apply to the image.
Table 87: image /PtData is optional PDF 2.0 and specifies extended geospatial data that shall apply to the image.

§12.10.2 Table 269 defines GEO mappings for 2D object space; Bounds coordinates are relative to the unit square for a viewport, form XObject, or image XObject. Effective EC3 #533 makes LPTS required, and its text says LPTS maps that square to the rectangular bounds of the containing image/form/viewport.

§12.10.5 makes PtData optional for a 2D GEO object; it describes extended point-associated values, with Names as column headings and XPTS tuples without guaranteed ordering or point-to-point relationship. No presentation procedure is specified there.
source.errata_overlay_check: Inspected annotations directly on physical 276, 617–618, and 620–621. Physical 276 has navigation links to Tables 266/272 but no erratum altering the Table 87 Measure/PtData rows. EC3 #533 and #534 appear on physical 618; #533 makes LPTS required, which the fixture includes.

features.source_rule: A present image /Measure is defined to apply scale and units to the image; GEO registration uses image XObject position coordinates and its bounds/LPTS mapping.
features.current_consumer: viewer_core::Query::Measure is a live interactive page-path feature. viewer-core/src/viewer/geometry.rs::measured converts screen points to page default user space, then reads only page /VP via measurement::Viewports::read. The PDF content interpreter transforms an image into Command::Image with a CTM, but the measurement query does not inspect those image commands or their source dictionaries.
features.assertions: viewer-core/tests/measuring.rs and measurement_numeric_spec_audit.rs verify the page /VP route and numeric scale selection. Model tests cover viewport GEO registration. No assertion uses an image XObject /Measure. Existing image tests are about decoding/rendering and do not invoke Query::Measure.
features.status: Strong consumer gap candidate: the application already offers the relevant interactive measurement tool, but a valid image-only GEO registration is invisible to that query. Scratch draft uses an image-space registration and literal geospatial position, with a matched page-viewport positive control. This is a semantic/query behavior finding, not a pixel-rendering defect.

features.source_rule: Optional Table 87 /PtData applies extended geospatial data to the image; Table 272 defines columns/tuples and expressly gives no ordering or relationship among tuples.
features.current_consumer: measurement::point_data parses dictionaries only when explicitly passed a viewport dictionary. Image decoding/painting does not expose a semantic PtData query; Query::Measure returns position/measurement state, not arbitrary extended columns.
features.assertions: measurement model tests exercise PtData on viewports. No public UI/query assertion uses image-attached PtData.
features.status: No distinct reader-facing omission established. Neither source clause defines displaying arbitrary PtData columns or a consumer action for them. Do not turn missing image PtData UI into a defect without an adopted extraction/query contract.

scope_limits: A PDF producer may omit either optional image entry; the candidate concerns a present, valid image Measure in an application that already exposes measurement.
No claim about rendering, image decoding, all image transforms, PtData UI, every geospatial method, or output-device behavior.
The public test target is a simple geographic registration with explicit WKT and LPTS; it does not rely on an EPSG registry, external projection libraries, or a different renderer.
